title: Two City Scheduling
statement:
A company is flying `m` candidates in for interviews, where `m` is even. Each candidate `i` has two quotes: `a[i]` is the cost of flying them to city A, and `b[i]` is the cost of flying them to city B.

The company must send **exactly `m / 2` candidates to city A and exactly `m / 2` candidates to city B**. Every candidate goes to exactly one city.

Print the minimum possible total cost.
inputFormat:
The first line contains the even integer `m`.
Each of the next `m` lines contains two integers `a[i]` and `b[i]`.
outputFormat: Print one integer: the minimum total cost.

examples.explanation: Send candidates 0 and 2 to city A (5 + 2) and candidates 1 and 3 to city B (3 + 6), for a total of 16.
Send candidate 0 to city B (cost 1) and candidate 1 to city A (cost 1). The other assignment would cost 200.

hints: Imagine first sending everyone to city A. Each candidate you then move to city B changes the total by `b[i] - a[i]`.
You must move exactly half the candidates, so move the ones whose change `b[i] - a[i]` is smallest.
Sort the candidates by `a[i] - b[i]`. The first half go to city A, the rest go to city B.
